name: app-strategy-plan-zigzag-dotted-path-with-avatars
title: Strategy Plan on a Zigzag Dotted Path
whatItIs: A grey slide titled Strategy Plan where a dotted line snakes down the page connecting three circular portraits, each above a paragraph with dark and grey phrases, a name and a role.
whatItMeans: A winding line turns a list of contributors into a story, and the grey phrases emphasise key decisions.
techniques: Alternating left and right text blocks

vocabulary.definition: A line that alternates direction to link items.
A statement attributed to a team member.
A circular photo used as a stop on a path.
